ideas.title: Following the Money in Pandemic-Related Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of pandemic-related fraud cases, including the Minnesota pandemic fraud case
questions: How did the perpetrators of the Minnesota pandemic fraud case launder their funds?
What financial institutions were used to facilitate the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between different entities and individuals involved in pandemic-related fraud. This could lead to further investigations and prosecutions.
